title: Lights in the Water
style: Cinematic painted key art for a modern real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer box art: dramatic light, rich colour, crisp detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: tense nocturnal cinematic underscore, soft oud and frame drum, deep strings, sea-wind pads, a lonely trumpet motif, a sense of searching, warm resolve at the end, no vocals

shots.prompt: Night on a reef coast: a small fishing fleet stranded on a reef line, wooden boats tilted in the white surf, lanterns and torch beams on the water, the lights of a fishing town on the shore behind, moonlight through clouds, tense.
shots.line: The navigation lied to every boat at once. The fleet is on the reef.

shots.prompt: Seen from high above at night through a green night-vision camera: three dark patrol boats with no markings in a line, bright white searchlight beams sweeping the black water, white surf breaking on a reef line below, clear and detailed, green monochrome surveillance look.
shots.line: Patrol boats with no flag are already searching the water. They are looking for someone.

shots.prompt: Keep this man's face, beard, scarf and uniform exactly. Move him to a dark beach road at night beside the same dusty pickup, moonlight and the red glow of a torch on his face, the sea behind him, determined and quiet.
shots.line: Captain Nabil Haidar takes a small team. No base, no noise.

shots.prompt: Two fishermen in plain civilian work clothes and knitted caps, on a small wooden fishing boat stranded on a reef at night, pulling a young woman out of the sea: she wears a soaked 1950s military uniform and webbing, dark hair plastered to her face, gasping, lit by a hand torch, waves breaking behind them.
shots.line: On the third boat, the crew has pulled someone out of the water who should not be there.
shots.action: The fishermen haul her over the side as a wave breaks behind them.

shots.prompt: Inside a small town clinic just before dawn: survivors wrapped in grey blankets sitting on simple cots, a nurse handing out cups of tea, fishermen in knitted caps, warm lamp light, the first pale light of dawn over the sea through a large window, calm and safe after danger.
shots.line: Find all three crews. Bring every survivor to the clinic.
